stories.headline: Windows 11's built-in Weather app wastes more than 1 GB of RAM
stories.summary: Microsoft has been working to make Windows 11 more efficient on PCs with limited RAM, but one of its own built-in applications appears to be working against that goal.  According to tests published by Windows Latest, the operating system's Weather app can consume more than 1 GB of memory despite performing a relatively simple task.
